candidates.issues: Accurate and natural overall. "Брауни" is repeated, and "шоколадные капли не растопятся" is a bit heavy. Decimal points are used instead of commas.
Slightly awkward word order in "форму размером 8 дюймов пергаментом". Otherwise natural. Decimal points are used instead of commas.
Smooth, idiomatic phrasing ("перелейте", "выньте", "перед нарезкой"). The only minor issue is decimal points instead of commas.
The title "Влажный брауни" is flat. "Хлопьевидной" is slightly clunky. "Пока они не растопятся" has an ambiguous referent. Awkward word order in the line about the pan.
Flaky sea salt is rendered as "крупного помола" (coarse ground), which is a different product. Vanilla extract is reduced to "ваниль".
"Фаджи-брауни" is an unidiomatic transliteration. Grammar error in "после того, как выньте" (should be "вынете"). "Сразу" is added.
